prepareDrawing

public void prepareDrawing(DrawingSpecifications drawingSpecifications)
Description copied from class: ElementDrawer
Initialize the drawer before drawing the text. This method is called once before drawing a whole MDC text. implementations of ElementDrawer can override this method ; if so, they should call super.prepareDrawing(drawingSpecifications) at some time.

visitCartouche

public void visitCartouche(Cartouche c)
Specified by:
visitCartouche in interface ModelElementVisitor
Specified by:
visitCartouche in class ElementDrawer
See Also:
NOTE: Cartouches are drawn larger than the typical cadrat Height, so that the signs in the cartouche be as tall as the ones outside. The cartouche positioning is done with setStartPoint(). If a Layout modifies the cartouche's startPoint, it won't work. So we might be interested in having a slightly richer model for views, with kinds of "alignment points", usable for horizontal and vertical positionning. TODO : use a simpler system for dimensions. Currently, the "specification" class knows too many things, and it makes a good realisation complicated.
